_readme: Trades are hand-edited ideas + script-evaluated status. SLATE model: up to one active idea per coin (max 5), listed in slate.coins[coin] = {trade_id | null, note}. Fields: id, coin, direction long|short, leverage (3 default), entry (planned; replaced by fill price when filled, original kept in planned_entry), entry_zone {low, high} (optional), stop, targets[], opened_at, expiry (fill deadline for pending; legacy fill_by also accepted), expires (optional max hold for open trades), status pending|open|won|lost|stopped|cancelled, missed_it {max_entry, note}, reasoning. Script fills targets_hit/filled_at/closed_at/exit_price/pnl_pct/unrealized_pnl_pct/mark_price. Times are ISO-8601; no offset = US Central.

trades.reasoning: Seed trade (owner-specified): XRP long from the 1.33 area with a stop under 1.28 and targets at 1.40 / 1.42. (Opening time assumed to be the start of Oct 16, 2026 Central since no exact time was given.)

SEED IDEA. Don't chase XRP at $1.38 into 1.42 resistance; instead bid a pullback to $1.35 (today's breakout/consolidation zone above the 1.33 pivot). Stop $1.305 sits under RoboForex's H4 support (1.309) and the Oct 19–20 range, so the idea is invalidated if the bounce fails. T1 $1.42 = H4/7-day resistance; T2 $1.47 = bull-case projection. Risk −3.3% (−10.0% at 3x) vs. +5.2% / +8.9% (+15.6% / +26.7% at 3x). [Originally posted at 5x; changed to 3x on Oct 21.] Limit order: cancels if not filled by Oct 23 11:05 AM CT. Risks: BTC losing $82.5K, Fed Oct 27–28. Entry zone 1.345–1.355 added Oct 21 for the slate model (centered on the original 1.35 limit, ≈ the 1h EMA20).

The first real retest is the old range top: the Oct 21 09:00 UTC high 1.3673 plus the 15:00–17:00 UTC hourly lows (1.372–1.3758). Stop 1.348 sits below the 1h EMA20 (1.358) and the 13:00 UTC low (1.3508); a close there means the breakout failed. Target 1.42 = the H4/7-day resistance (same as T1). R:R 1.67 from 1.375 (worst fill), 2.6 from 1.368. Breakout chase rejected: buying a 1h close above 1.42 into the 1.47 projection / 1.50 resistance with a stop back under 1.40 is only ~1.1:1.

If XLM rolls over without rallying into 0.1895–0.1915, a breakdown short (1h close below the Oct 21 0.1808 base / 4h EMA20 0.1809, stop above the 0.1842 Oct 21 08:00 UTC high) runs straight into the 0.177–0.1775 support: about 0.6:1 from 0.18. missed_plan.trigger: Range floor holds: a 1h candle dips into 0.002385–0.00241 and closes at or above 0.002385
missed_plan.size_note: Half size at 2x: a chase entry in a thin small-cap; the stop is only ~3–4% away and can get wicked.
missed_plan.reasoning: ZBCN tagged 0.002482 (Oct 21 11:00 UTC) and has ranged since: the 12:00–18:00 UTC hourly lows sit at 0.002377–0.002403, so the range floor is ~0.00239. It never came back to the 0.0023–0.00234 bid. Missed-it move: buy a held retest of that floor. Stop 0.00231 is below the 1h EMA20 (0.002345) and the 07:00 UTC low (0.002327); losing it means the range broke down. Target 0.00258 = the resistance level (same as T1). R:R 1.7 from 0.00241 (worst fill), 2.6 from 0.002385. Breakout chase rejected: a 1h close above 0.0025 hits 0.00258 resistance within ~3%, about 0.7:1 with a stop back inside the range. Risk: the 1h MACD just crossed bearish on low volume (0.57x), so this can fail.

stats.note: Cumulative P&L is the simple sum of per-trade % returns at each trade's leverage (equal size per trade).

slate.rules: Max one active (pending/open) idea per coin, max 6 at once; long or short; 'no setup' is allowed. New trades default to 3x.
